changes.title: Angry legend line
items: An angry legend's note now says it also settles back to sleep when one of its children is back in its area

changes.title: Happy pickup
items: A creature you've won over drops its sigil as a rune at its feet: stand by it and press E to bring it into your party (no second round of 💌s)

changes.title: Legend rim
items: Small stones, toadstools, stumps and posts edge each sleeping legend's circle, in its area's own kind, leaving the way in open
